meta.name: securability-engineering
meta.description: Meta-skill that wraps code generation to enforce FIASSE securable coding attributes and principles. Use when generating, scaffolding, or refactoring code so that the output is engineered to be inherently securable by default. Applies the nine SSEM attributes (Analyzability, Modifiability, Testability, Confidentiality, Accountability, Authenticity, Availability, Integrity, Resilience), the Transparency principle, and FIASSE defensive coding practices to every code generation task. Invoke this skill alongside or instead of raw code generation when the user asks for secure code, securable code, FIASSE-compliant code, or when generating security-sensitive components (auth, input handling, data access, API endpoints, trust boundaries).
